items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: Roy (Eldridge) was in the band and Teddy (Wilson) was in the band

ctx.x: music director. The band was called Willie Jones' band. But Jones left, Willie Jones -- I don't know what happened to him.

Anyway, we got together, you know, with Speed, and Speed had very many promises, as they all do have. But nothing but promises. That's all. You dig? So we scuffled, and... Roy (Eldridge) was in the band and Teddy (Wilson) was in the band, and their brothers -- both had brothers, you know, and they were in the band.

items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, everybody I've talked to who was in that band, Vic and Teddy, they all say the same thing

ctx.x: So then I went with Speed Webb. That was a good band. A very good band. I just wish that band could have got to New York, to ...(?)...(?)... I think that band would have still been going today. That band was as good as Lunceford's or any of those bands, really.
Yeah, everybody I've talked to who was in that band, Vic and Teddy, they all say the same thing -- it was a great band.
